scales.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl tracking-tight leading-none font-bold text-zinc-900
scales.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl tracking-tight leading-snug font-semibold text-zinc-900
scales.label: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-zinc-500

admin_dashboard.structure: Sidebar left (w-64 or w-72), Map Config View right (flex-1). The map canvas takes up 100% of the available area in the right pane. Floating control panels on top of the map for tools (drag beacons, define aisles).
admin_dashboard.spacing: Dense, utilitarian spacing. Container padding p-4 to p-6.

customer_mobile.structure: Full-screen map viewer using react-zoom-pan-pinch. Top floating glassmorphic bar for search. Bottom sheet (drawer) for route steps, aisle navigation, and proximity promos.
customer_mobile.spacing: Mobile-first, touch-friendly. 16px to 24px container paddings, minimum 48px touch targets.

interactive_map.container: relative overflow-hidden w-full h-full bg-zinc-200 border border-zinc-300 rounded-xl
interactive_map.floor_plan_image: absolute inset-0 object-contain w-full h-full opacity-90 mix-blend-multiply
interactive_map.beacon_marker: absolute w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 border-2 border-white shadow-md z-10. Animate pulse for active state.
interactive_map.user_location_dot: absolute w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-blue-600 border-2 border-white shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,85,255,0.6)] z-20.
interactive_map.routing_path: SVG dashed line connecting aisle nodes, colored in brand wayfinding_blue with stroke-dasharray animation.

admin_sidebar.style: bg-white border-r border-zinc-200 h-screen p-6 flex flex-col gap-8
admin_sidebar.links: flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 hover:text-zinc-900 transition-colors

bottom_sheet_customer.style: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-white rounded-t-3xl shadow-[0_-10px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] p-6 z-50
bottom_sheet_customer.drag_handle: w-12 h-1.5 bg-zinc-300 rounded-full mx-auto mb-6

promo_toast.style: fixed top-20 left-4 right-4 bg-orange-500 text-white p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-xl flex items-center gap-4 z-50 overflow-hidden
promo_toast.animation: Slide in from top, gentle bounce.

shadcn_overrides.Button: rounded-lg font-medium transition-transform active:scale-95. Primary is solid black, accent is blue.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons lift slightly (-translate-y-0.5) and gain a soft shadow.
motion_and_interactions.beacon_pulse: Framer motion infinite pulse animation for active ESP32 beacons (scale 1 to 1.5, opacity 0.8 to 0).
motion_and_interactions.route_draw: SVG path stroke-dashoffset animation to simulate drawing the path to the aisle.

floor_plan_default.description: Minimal architectural floor plan for admin setup and customer map view.

promo_icon_3d.description: 3D promo icon to use in proximity marketing toast notifications.

product_grocery_1.description: Grocery store filled with foods - background or category image.

product_item.description: Yellow and green box - sample product image for search results.

testing_attributes.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements MUST have role-based, kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., admin-sidebar-upload-map, customer-search-input, customer-promo-toast).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `react-zoom-pan-pinch` for the floor plan viewer. The map must support pinch-to-zoom on mobile and wheel zoom on desktop.
Use `framer-motion` for animating the 'you are here' dot and proximity promo popups.
Admin and Mobile views should be separated logically in routing (e.g. /admin vs /).
Admin dashboard must implement a split pane layout where the left is a configuration sidebar, and the right is a large interactive canvas.
Customer view must be strictly mobile-first. A full-screen map with overlaid search bar at top and a bottom sheet for directions/info.
Overlay HTML/SVG elements on top of the image in the zoom-pan container to represent the ESP32 beacons and user's location dot.
Use sonner or a custom absolute overlay for proximity promo toasts so they appear prominent and actionable over the map.
Ensure high-contrast text rendering. Use the specified fonts (Outfit for headers, Manrope for body text).
